name: Zhejiang Taitan Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Taitan Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of textile machinery in China and internationally. The company offers spinning equipment and weaving equipment, such as rotor spinning machines, doubling twisters, texturing machines, precision winding machines, and drawing frames, as well as rapier looms, air-jet looms, water-jet looms, and flat knitting machines. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Xinchang, China. Zhejiang Taitan Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shaoxing Taitan Investment Co., Ltd.
